feed.title: MX Royale News – Updates of the Browser Motocross Game

entry.title: Website in five languages, new screenshots and a press kit
entry.summary: mxroyale.com now has pages in English, German, Spanish, French and Brazilian Portuguese – the same five languages as the game. Every track has a new in-game screenshot, and the press page has a downloadable press kit with logo, key art, eight screenshots and a fact sheet. In the game, the track menu now shows real shots of each track and the time-trial leaderboard got a new look.

entry.title: Open beta: MX Royale is live
entry.summary: MX Royale is now open to everyone at play.mxroyale.com – free, in the browser, with no download and no account needed. The open beta starts with 15 race tracks and 2 freeride maps, races against AI riders, time trial with ghosts, the Daily Challenge, a Championship, the trick school and online races with friends via room code. Found a bug? Write to feedback@mxroyale.com.
